name: om-test-runtime
description: React runtime and DOM for om's ClojureScript test suite. Not published; om itself declares no npm dependencies.

scripts.test: clojure -M -m shadow.cljs.devtools.cli compile test && node out/test.js
scripts.test:react-matrix: for v in 16.14.0 17.0.2 18.3.1; do npm i --no-save --no-audit --no-fund react@$v react-dom@$v && npm test || exit 1; done
